name: ASK artwork palettes
about: Opt-in artwork color data: four shared named palettes ASK artwork may paint; an artwork may use its own ASK-approved palette instead. Spec owner: visual-identity-system.md, Artwork palettes; it wins where the two differ. An artwork resource only: it creates no interface color role, and a value here asserts no semantic state. The interface tokens are colors_and_type.css. How often each color is drawn, transparency, ground and rendering belong to each artwork. Order is part of the data: an artwork that picks colors by index from a seeded sequence depends on it. `version` rises when a palette is added or removed, or a color or its position changes. Python reads the file directly; a served page reads it with fetch, which a page opened from disk cannot do.

base.about: The muted-purple base all four palettes share. `rare` members are meant to appear more rarely than `common` ones.
